title: Client Account Administrator
subtitle: It opens and closes a sub-account for each client or brand, sets each one's plan and features, groups them, and hands the right people access with single sign-on links.
lede: It opens and closes a sub-account for each client or brand, sets each one's plan and features, groups them, and hands the right people access with single sign-on links. It takes the account paperwork off the owner's desk and keeps every brand separated.
who: an agency owner or a company running several brands
author: Corey James
